Interface Role

All Known Implementing Classes:
RoleJson
public interface Role
A named set of role actions that can be granted to a principal, as returned by the IAM roles catalog (GET /v1/roles, operationId listRoles; and GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/roles, operationId listRolesByProjectId).

This is a read-only response view (spec schema RoleDetails).
